{{Quote|I know the difference between a demon and a Devaronian and I'd rather trust a demon.|[[Naradan D'ulin]]|<ref name="Deal with a Demon">{{Tales|3|Deal with a Demon}}</ref>}}
'''Devaronians''' were a horned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species from the world of [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of low mountains and deep valleys linked by thousands of rivers. It was believed that they were descended from a [[Devaronian precursor species|race of primates that lived in the mountains of Devaron]], and that their horns were a genetic mutation that proved useful in fending off predatory birds.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|Devaronians are tough; I know that about you. You do not go into shock and you do not die easily.|Boba Fett, to Malloc|<ref name="The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett">{{StoryCite|story=The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>}}
[[File:Devaronian_female_FDNP.png|thumb|left|150px|A female Devaronian.]]
A bipedal mammalian [[Species/Legends|species]], Devaronians evolved in the dense [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] as a [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]]-gather species. Their bodies were denser than most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]' and as a result they were heavier than their appearance would tend to indicate.<ref name="Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>
Devaronians had [[Color/Legends|silver]]-based [[Blood/Legends|blood]], which appeared thick and black when exposed. They possessed a unique blood filtration and cleansing system which processed through two [[Liver/Legends|livers]]. Because their bodies were constantly cleansed of toxins and carcinogens, the species was highly resistant to [[Poison/Legends|poison]]. To this end, [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfur]] was used as a stimulant on Devaron to enhance speed and strength, because inhaling it caused the substance to enter the bloodstream rapidly. Their livers struggled to eliminate sulfur from their system, meaning that long-term use could be dangerous.<ref name="NoP" />

The Devaronians were one of the more unusual races in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], with a dramatic gender dimorphism in appearance and temperament. The males were aggressive by nature, many being described as brash or bull-headed, with typically red-tinted skin and a pair of large [[Horn/Legends|horns]] growing from their heads. They took great pride in their horns, and groomed them quite regularly. Many species felt uncomfortable in their presence, for they resembled the [[Demon/Legends|devils]] of a thousand different myths.<ref name="A Guide to the Star Wars Universe (Third Edition)">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>

[[Gender/Legends|Female]] Devaronians were covered in thick fur that ranged in color from brown to white, hornless and had prominent canine [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. They were docile, non-aggressive creatures. They tended to be dominant in their culture, being the only ones allowed to participate in government and politics. Several female Devaronians not covered with thick fur revealed two dark circles above the forehead, where the horns usually were in males.

<div style="float:right">[[File:Devaronian_tracker_FDNP.png|thumb|200px|A male Devaronian tracker.]]</div>
In addition, the teeth of the males were all sharp incisors, but the females also had molars and prominent canines. One in fifty Devaronian males had two sets of teeth, however, having an inner set of sharp "male" teeth and an outer, retractable set of "female" teeth. In primitive times, such males were used as solitary [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] by Devaronian tribes, since they could survive on either meat or plants. Males also had an extremely long [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]], though whether females shared this trait is unknown. The teeth were useful for some [[Language/Legends|languages]]. A Devaronian had to continually and repeatedly retract and extend both sets of teeth to speak [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], causing aches over time.

==Society and culture==
First devising the [[Tumbledrive/Legends|tumble hyperdrive]] around [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]], Devaronians were one of the first species in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] to develop interstellar travel. The males of the species had been common sights in [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] throughout the galaxy for thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

[[File:Devaronian-SOTETC.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Devaronian male extending his tongue towards [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].]]
Devaronian males were driven by an urge to wander, usually taking the first opportunity to move on from one place to another. As such, they were often found traveling the galaxy as tramp freighter [[Captain/Legends|captains]] and scouts. Female Devaronians, on the other hand, were content to remain in a single location, and, as such, raised the young and ran the government of Devaron. The males sent as much money as they could manage back to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to support their families, but otherwise hardly ever returned once they had begun to travel the [[Star/Legends|stars]]. The females were content with this arrangement, as they tended to view the restless males as disruptive to home life.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /> Mating rituals consisted of the season of Koh'hibril. Females were dominant therefore, as that was the only time couples spend long periods together. "[[Oshmahr]]" was a mid-day meal ceremony of the Devaronians.

[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] was found in higher frequencies among Devaronians than in other species. Despite this, no strong Force-based tradition emerged on Devaron or among their colonies. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] established the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Eedit Temple]] on Devaron to train the Forceful [[Youngling/Legends|children]] there, with females making up the larger percentage of students as males desired to travel more than the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] culture permitted.<ref name="NoP" />

==Devaronians in the galaxy==
{{Quote|I've seen two Devaronians my whole life. They've got red skin and two big horns on their heads.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]]|<ref name="TOR:TTT">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Tatooine Target|the D5-Mantis}}</ref>}}
Sometime during the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], one [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]], a captain in the Devaronian Army, received the order to put down a [[Battle of Montellian Serat|rebellion]] against the Empire on Devaron. The rebels were taking refuge in the ancient city of Montellian Serat. He shelled the city until the rebels surrendered, then finished it, turning the city to rubble. When he received more orders to move south to another group of rebels, interpreting them as ordering mass executions, he herded the seven hundred rebels into a holding pen, then had the guards open fire. He assumed the name [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Labria]] and went into hiding after his fellow Devaronians placed one of the galaxy's highest [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] on his head for his deadly wartime activities. He was seen in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] came looking for passage offworld.

[[File:Sanya.png|thumb|right|180px|[[Sanya]], a female [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|AgriCorps]] member]]
Nevertheless, very few Devaronians joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>

The infamous Devaronian, [[Vilmarh Grahrk]], was a [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] active during the latter days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Kapp Dendo]], served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and eventually became a general in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military.

==Behind the scenes==
The first appearance of Devaronians was in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] (in the background of the Mos Eisley Cantina) and only appeared there because the costume department ran out of alien costumes for the extras and used a second-hand "devil" costume.
